notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator - Patch version 0.10.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, <3

I've prepared many of the items I shared in the devlog and I'm uploading a patch over the weekend to improve your gaming experience. 

This patch includes:
-Instore product sale prices have been increased.
-Stock Exchange can now drop share values to 0. If it drops to 0, you can lose your entire portfolio :)
-Store Restockers can now place the boxes they are going to return back on the shelf they picked them up from.
-Store Restockers now have more intuitive behavior. They are more oriented to different shelves. 
-There was a lack of feedback in the Auto Sale Zone. It was reinforced with voice and text.
-Forklift reset option added (same button as Car reset)
-Fixed shoe texture bug on shelves.
-Fixed Level text growth issue.
-Smart watch prices were not showing on the shelves. Fixed.
-Storage Racks have been visually improved.

Npc stuck problem will be fixed in the next update. I found the source of the problem but I couldn't include it in this update because it will take a little longer to fix it. I postponed it to the next update in order not to keep it waiting in that process. (you can send me screenshots related to this issue via discord)

In addition, if anyone has experienced the bug of missing a product after each delivery while placing products in the vehicle with autoload, can you tell me the more detailed scenario over discord? 

Thank you very much for your support and understanding. Good games, have fun! <3

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator - Patch version 0.9.1
notes.content:
Helloo everyone <3

as I mentioned in the previous update note, I had to spend some time on optimization. optimization is never finished and I decided to upload a patch as part 1 optimization. 

The content of this patch:

-Optimization
-Bug fix
-economy design changes

In a few days I have some surprises for you and I will prepare them and upload another part of optimization updates. 

According to my tests, on some computers it is more efficient to turn off the shadow settings and use the number of lights more optimally.  

Keep the feedback and bug reports coming. We are improving the game together :)

notes.title: WHOLESALE ZONE UPDATE
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone,

As I shared in the previous update note, in this update I added the most requested automatic wholesale zone to the game. 

I will upload the car loader as soon as possible, but I wanted to at least upload the wholesale automatic sale zone as it is complete.  

If you have an active order, when you bring your vehicle to the area in the image, if the vehicle contains the box of that product, an information box will appear and it will automatically load all the boxes in the vehicle.

Of course there is a cost for this and you will have to spend a little bit of money to open each zone :)

notes.title: TRUCK UPDATE
notes.content:
Hellooo everyone, 

I know it was very much wanted. You had a hard time fitting the panel van into the factory. 

Actually, I didn't design it to get trucks into the factory, but we are developing the game together. :)

 The level 3 factory gate is now wide enough to fit a truck inside :)

And it doesn't stop there. If it's wide enough for a truck, I added a truck to the game :) 

The price is a bit high, but our new truck with a capacity of 250 boxes has been added to the game. 

Thank you very much for your feedback and suggestions. 

I am happy to tell you the content of the next update: 
-Wholesale Restocker
-Automatic sales feature in wholesale areas

I continue to work. We develop together. <3

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator Update V 0.6.0
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone, <3

I didn't come with a big update this time because I had to do some optimization and bug fixing. But I added one of the most requested things. 

Now, if you hold down the right click while looking at a shelf, you can place the product back into the box. 

(It must be the same product or the box must be empty).

-As an extra, restockers used to go to the same shelf, now they go to different shelves and this is more realistic. 

-Bugs related to raw materials in the Machistart application have been fixed. (Thank you very much for reporting.)

-In the label system, the prices of design products were not updating or showing incorrectly. Fixed.

-Minor bugs were fixed and some optimization was done. 

Keep working, I have new surprises soon :)

notes.title: BIG UPDATE 2
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone, <3

I haven't uploaded an update for a few days because I've been building an automation system. It's been requested a lot from you and I hope you enjoy it without any problems. 

Keep up the good work. Thank you to everyone who helped us develop the game.

We are developing it together. 

After hiring the automation engineer, you can choose how many products you want to produce from the “Machistart” application and leave the rest to the automation engineer. (You have to buy the raw material and if you cancel the production, the raw material is refunded. )

I am waiting for your comments and suggestions. Have fun <3

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone,

As promised, I didn't keep you waiting for the update. please forgive me for a few days. :) 

I am very happy to share the big update with you all, we are developing our game together, thank you all very much. Feel free to tell me what you want me to add. 

Keep working hard!  <3

UPDATE NOTES
- Tag system for Racks
- Store Restockers will no longer randomize. They will only place them on shelves with tags. 
- The number of Store Restockers has been increased to 5.
- The number of Factory Restockers has been increased to 5. 
- I placed a screen in the factory and now you will be able to read daily reports from there.
(I have not added unnecessary information here. Let me know what information you need and we will improve the statistics panel together).
- Completed bank loans are now active again.
- In the raw material tab in the shopping application, you can now enter 3 digit input.
- Other bug fixes
- Optimization

notes.content:
Added restocker for the store to the game.
To use it correctly, you need to get the store storage rack at the bottom of the Shopping-Interior tab. In this way, the products you produce for wholesale will not be mixed with store products. The restocker will only transport the products placed on this rack to the store.

notes.title: DEVLOG #17
notes.content:
Helloooo everyone,

Today I improved the customization options for our store and factory signage. And I know the image in the prologue version was very annoying. The color tones and look felt very cheap. 

Now we can adjust the font size to our liking. There will be many new features like light color, light brightness, outer frame color, inner background color, text color. 

I need your advice for this customization screen, which camera angle do you think is more beautiful? Or if there is an angle you think would be better, you can recommend :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/5d0e8827b03a65135813bfbb1efddbc00d03c6ef.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016123/81431899d1137a082a3ffb415c2dce057c254307.png

In addition to these;
-Now we will be able to give customers more or less money. 
-I turned off the interaction with other objects while interacting with the cash register.
-I seriously improved the vehicle mechanics. 
-Player movement has been significantly improved and there is no more unnecessary flying and most importantly, it's not nauseating (I did it from scratch)
-Customers are paying more realistic prices.
- When buying raw materials, we don't increase them by clicking on the button one by one, in addition, I added keyboard input there.
-I activated driver support in low quality settings (computer wouldn't turn on, I apologize).
-The store ceiling was too low. We received a lot of feedback on this and now we have a more spacious environment.
-Cost of production is gone (but the game is more difficult now)
-I'm continuing many bug fixes and improvements like these. Level design will be a lot of fun. :)
